entries.label: Rogue Russia
entries.summary: A humiliated Russia becomes a dangerous rogue state threatening Europe, the US and others.
entries.quote: A humiliated Russia will turn from global player into the world's most dangerous rogue state, posing a serious security threat to Europe, the United States, and beyond.

entries.label: Maximum Xi
entries.summary: Xi Jinping holds unrivalled power after the 20th Party Congress, with few checks on his decisions.
entries.quote: Xi Jinping emerged from China's 20th Party Congress in October 2022 with a grip on power unrivaled since Mao Zedong.

entries.label: Weapons of mass disruption
entries.summary: New technologies help autocrats undermine democracy abroad and suppress dissent at home.
entries.quote: New technologies will be a gift to autocrats bent on undermining democracy abroad and stifling dissent at home.

entries.label: Inflation shockwaves
entries.summary: Higher interest rates and global recession raise the risk of emerging-market crises.
entries.quote: Rising interest rates and global recession will raise the risk of emerging-market crises.

entries.label: Iran in a corner
entries.summary: The chance of Iranian regime collapse is still low but the highest in four decades.
entries.quote: The chance of regime collapse is low, but it's higher than at any point in the past four decades.

entries.label: Energy crunch
entries.summary: Higher oil prices raise friction between OPEC+ and the United States.
entries.quote: Higher oil prices will also increase frictions between OPEC+ and the United States.

entries.label: Arrested global development
entries.summary: Progress in human development goes into reverse, with women and girls hit hardest.
entries.quote: Women and girls will suffer the most, losing hard-earned rights, opportunities, and security.

entries.label: Divided States of America
entries.summary: The risk of political violence in the US continues.
entries.quote: There is a continuing risk of political violence in the US, even as some who participated in the Capitol riots go to prison.

entries.label: Tik Tok boom
entries.summary: Gen Z online activism reshapes corporate and public policy and disrupts politics.
entries.quote: Gen Z has both the ability and the motivation to organize online to reshape corporate and public policy, making life harder for multinationals everywhere and disrupting politics with the click of a button.

entries.label: Water stress
entries.summary: Water stress becomes a global, systemic problem that governments still treat as temporary.
entries.quote: This year, water stress will become a global and systemic challenge...while governments will still treat it as a temporary crisis.
